topics.topic: Handling of composed flow references to non-existent contract_version_id or binding_id
questions: If a composed flow version references a non-existent contract_version_id or binding_id, must compose be refused as unknown_reference (nothing kept), or kept with proof failure at phase 1?

topics.topic: Policy for collisions between required_headers and implicit/credential headers
questions: If required_headers contains a name that collides with implicit protocol headers (host/content-type/content-length/accept-encoding) or credential header, should proposal be refused, overridden, or sent with duplicates?

topics.topic: Required behavior when trap telemetry write to parent channel fails
questions: What is the required behavior if writing the trap hit to the parent channel itself fails (channel full/broken/process crash) after a prohibited call occurred?

topics.topic: Rule for which element index to report when multiple `many` inputs fail validation
questions: When multiple elements of one `many` port fail schema/size, which element index must be reported as the failure reason?

topics.topic: Runtime equality semantics for guard comparison
questions: What exact equality semantics must be used for guard comparison at run time (e.g., numeric form differences, object key order, array deep equality)?

topics.topic: Validation policy for malformed read-operation idempotency_key in manifest during proposal/acceptance
questions: For a read operation, if manifest idempotency_key text is malformed (e.g., bad split syntax, duplicates, invalid field tokens), is proposal/acceptance refused as manifest mismatch or accepted because read keys are fully ignored?
